decision_note: The predeclared first-fold stop rule allows continuation. The current-row market block leads the frozen first-fold control by about 0.012802, while the three four-date path variants are only slightly above it on this single reused development fold. No variant is promoted from this probe; remaining folds are required for matched evidence.

failed_attempts_before_success.cause: SageMaker execution role lacked s3:GetObjectVersion for a version-pinned operational formatting receipt. The retry switched to the independently hash-checked current object rather than changing IAM.
The ignored logs directory did not exist before the external supervisor opened its log. A bounded no-training startup created the directory; the probe was then rerun unchanged.

limitations: This is one predeclared development fold, not a final validation result.
The probe does not establish that longer OHLC/activity paths improve the pooled 535-date metric.
The historical 0.63834 private leaderboard winner is not directly comparable with this development fold.
